normalization_freeze_and_sensitivity_202.frozen_primary_normalization: raw-count training-only StandardScaler (unchanged; the primary internal estimate remains +0.0333)
normalization_freeze_and_sensitivity_202.sensitivity_variant: log1p counts before the same training-only StandardScaler
normalization_freeze_and_sensitivity_202.rationale: log1p is a fixed monotone per-value transform, not a fitted statistic, so it leaks no held-out information; it tests whether the frozen null is normalization-dependent without replacing the primary endpoint
non_goals: does not change the frozen primary estimate, margin, or advantage rule
does not select a favourable variant after seeing results
